name: Sakagami Yukari
source:
Formerly known as: Tooyama Yukari, wife of Toshiya.

A composed beauty with a bright personality, she was quite popular but had absolutely no prior romantic experience (Toshiya being her first). 

However, even before marriage, she received instruction from her mother, Masae, and studied erotic techniques day and night for her future husband, Toshiya. 

Even now, after marriage, she continues to hone her skills.

[From [url=http://www.ps-web.net/tryset/A002/03_chara.html]official site[/url]]
